agentReview.why: This URL is one of several unrelated base paths in this batch that all have the same fixed suffix 'ai-appointment-booking/' appended (e.g. company pages, industry pages, service pages). That pattern points to a shared internal-linking component (a CTA block or related-services widget) that appends a hard-coded slug onto whatever page it renders on, rather than linking to the actual ai-appointment-booking page URL. Each rendering of that component on a different page produces a new guaranteed-404 link.
agentReview.fix: Locate the shared CTA/related-content component referencing 'ai-appointment-booking' and fix it to link to the correct absolute URL for that service page instead of concatenating a relative slug onto the current page's path. Because this renders on many pages, one template fix resolves all rows in this batch with the same suffix — verify by searching the codebase for the literal string 'ai-appointment-booking' in link-building logic.

agentReview.why: The href for this link concatenates a second absolute URL onto an already-absolute base (https://rytsensetech.com/us/https://rytsensetech.com/us/ai-agent-development-services/), so the browser and Googlebot request a path that can never exist. This is a template/CMS bug in how internal links are built (e.g. base_url + full_url instead of base_url + relative_path), not a missing page — the real destination is very likely live at the inner URL. Every occurrence wastes crawl budget on a guaranteed-404 and breaks the internal link graph to the real page.
agentReview.fix: Find the component/template that builds this href (likely a market-prefix wrapper that prepends the site origin + market segment to a value that is already a full URL) and fix it to detect an already-absolute URL and pass it through unchanged, or store only the relative path in the CMS field. Grep the codebase/CMS for the literal pattern in this URL to find every other instance (this bug is systemic, not isolated — see related rows in this batch). After the template fix, 301 any already-indexed broken variants to the real inner URL and resubmit the affected pages in GSC.
